reader_question: How long have today’s federal judges served?
grade_line: Documented: the Federal Judicial Center’s directory of federal judges
title: The 845 federal judges in active service in November 2026 had served a median of 8.0 years.
measure_line: Judges in active service on November 11, 2026, by years since each one’s first appointment as a federal judge, in two-year bins: judges of the Supreme Court, the courts of appeals, the district courts and the Court of International Trade, who serve for life under Article III of the Constitution.
reading_guide: Each column counts the judges whose service falls in its two years. The dashed line marks the median: half the judges had served less, and half more.
notes: Each of the 845 judges in active service counts once, including four who serve more than one district. A judge who takes senior status still hears cases but leaves this count, and a judge promoted to a higher court counts from the first appointment, so a promotion does not restart the years.
Years run back from November 11, 2026, so each bin’s edges fall on November 11 of an even year and never on an inauguration day.
alt: Columns count federal judges in active service by years since their first appointment, in two-year bins from 0 to 44 years. The tallest column, 6 to under 8 years, holds 130 of the 845 judges; counts thin out past 16 years, and the median is 8.0 years.

table.caption: The 845 federal judges in active service, each counted once, by years as a federal judge, November 11, 2026

chart_notes: The dashed line marks the median, 8.0 years. Each column is two years wide, from 0 to 44 years.
notes_internal: Maker B, round 2. Data plan row 54, rule 14.58. Ruling (a): no single named mark; the columns take the subject ink and the median the (b) line, dashed in the text’s ink with its own label in regular weight. Ruling (d): Finding, Documented.

labels.marker.value is the median of the 845 judges’ unrounded years (8.0246), checked by maker_b_round2_derive.py --figures (check S49): 845 judges, median 8.0 years, 6 to under 8 the tallest bin with 130, 22 bins, four judges with more than one record.

H09: the bins count back from November 11, 2026; January 20 of 2001, 2009, 2017, 2021 and 2025 sit 25.81, 17.81, 9.81, 5.81 and 1.81 years back, so no edge falls on an inauguration (ruling (g)).
